breadcrumb-divider._comment: OrigamBreadcrumbDivider — Lot 5D / #386. Independently-shipped component (packages/ds/src/components/Breadcrumb/OrigamBreadcrumbDivider.vue), not a BEM child of OrigamBreadcrumb — per the project convention each Origam*.vue file gets its own top-level component-token namespace (--origam-breadcrumb-divider---*), not a nested BEM-child one. Moved out of the `breadcrumb` block, where Style Dictionary emitted these as --origam-breadcrumb__divider---* — a name the component never reads.

color.$description: Color of the divider character or icon

font-size.$description: Font size of the divider character

character.$description: Default divider character (overridable via the divider prop)

padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding around the divider (gives breathing room between crumbs)

border-radius.$description: Border radius of the divider wrapper
